parameters.content:
## FIXED VERSION -- review before importing

This replaces the old "🔁 Process Each Product" SplitInBatches loop (and everything it drove downstream) with a single "▶️ Process Product (per item)" Execute Sub-workflow node running in "Run once for each item" mode, calling the new **Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL) - Process Product** sub-workflow.

Why: the old nested SplitInBatches setup hit a confirmed n8n platform bug -- live execution data showed it running 289 times but only producing real output twice, silently dropping almost every create/update for the rest of the catalog every run. See the sub-workflow's own README sticky note for the full explanation.

**Import both files, then**: open "▶️ Process Product (per item)" here and pick the sub-workflow from its dropdown (its ID doesn't exist until you import it, so it can't be pre-wired). Nothing else changed -- every other node, mutation, and piece of business logic is untouched, just relocated.

The original file this was built from is left completely unmodified.

**Price guard:** a row that is Ready_to_post but has no valid price in 'Price IN USD $ (Jack)' (blank, not a number, or 0) is never created. It goes down the existing 'mark false' path, which sets Ready_to_post back to "no". Before, a blank price became 0 and the product was published for free (LSLT046-054, order #1567). For updates, an invalid price is left out so an existing price is never overwritten with 0. The Process Product sub-workflow also refuses to create or price a product at 0 as a second guard.

**One return to the sheet loop:** '🔄 Loop Through Sheets' is a SplitInBatches node and must get exactly ONE return per sheet. 'Read Sheet Data' fans out into 3 parallel branches (product filter, CAD-Image11 sync, publish reconcile) and all of them used to loop back (Rate Limit, Sync Image URL11, Any Products to Check? false, Needs Publish? false, Check Publish Result) -- so the loop fired several times per sheet, its Done output ran repeatedly (a 21-product sheet showed 42 items) and the same products were sent on again (a 'Dedupe Duplicate Batches' node used to hide this by dropping repeats; it was removed once the loop had a single return -- its input and output counts were equal, 1403 in / 1403 out). Now the three stages run in one line per sheet -- Read Sheet Data -> Tag Sheet Rows -> CAD-Image11 sync -> publish reconcile -> product filter -> Rate Limit -> Loop -- and only Rate Limit returns to the loop, so the loop moves to the next sheet only after all the work for the current sheet is done. A step that can produce nothing (CAD sync with nothing to update, publish check with nothing to publish) rejoins through a Merge node (the '🔀 Join:' nodes) so the line never stops. 'Restore Sheet Rows' re-emits the sheet's rows (tagged with __sheet_name) for the stages that need them.

**Memory fix (two-phase sheet read):** each sheet used to be read in full (every column of every row) and kept in memory for the whole run -- thousands of rows with long text across ~30 sheets, copied again by the stages. Now: header row -> only the short columns the CAD sync / publish check / readiness check need, for all rows ('Build Slim Rows') -> after those stages, only the Ready_to_post rows are read in full ('Pick Ready Rows' -> 'Read Full Rows (ready only)' -> 'Build Full Rows') and sent to the unchanged product filter. The full rows are read after the CAD sync, so a ready row picks up the Fields_to_update / IMAGE URL11 the sync just wrote.

**Update lock (2026-10-23):** after fireplace feature photos changed on the live store, products that already exist on Shopify are locked. (1) '✅ Filter Unacknowledged & Ready to Post' has the switch `ALLOW_UPDATES_TO_PUBLISHED` (currently TRUE = updates allowed). Set it to false to stop every update to a product already on Shopify (the row is skipped with no Shopify call and no sheet write; only CREATE goes through). (2) '🗑️ Detect CAD-Image11 Sync' no longer sets Ready_to_post / Fields_to_update on published rows; it only mirrors the sheet's IMAGE URL11 cell. Rows the CAD sync flagged earlier are still queued in the sheet and would all update at once if the lock were turned on -- clear them first.
